sentences.text: For a non-individual borrower, the in-force UCB directions cited here do not place this case inside paragraph 261(1) or 261(2), and paragraph 261(5) says that in cases other than those paragraphs, pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB. [E6, E8, E9]

The product note’s 2% foreclosure charge for non-individual borrowers therefore does not conflict on the face of these cited RBI pre-payment rules, although the directions also require that any applicable charge be disclosed in the sanction letter and loan agreement. [E2, E14, E16]

missing.searched: The findings mention that paragraph 261 applies to loans and advances sanctioned or renewed on or after January 1, 2026, but no sanction date was provided for this loan.
